page_description: See what a past amount is worth in today's purchasing power. Calculated from Turkey's Consumer Price Index (CPI).
liveHint: Change the date or amount, the result updates instantly.
emptyHint: Enter an amount and pick a starting date.
provisionalWarning: Your chosen end month isn't published yet; the latest {{date}} data was used.
source: Source: TÜİK / CBRT EVDS · CPI (2003=100). Releases can lag by a few months.
